title: RuleFileSchema
description: Google Antigravity behavioral rule file frontmatter schema (GEMINI.md, AGENTS.md, .agents/rules/*.md). Rule bodies are plain Markdown; frontmatter is optional (see evidence/reports/R-003-rule-frontmatter-format.md).

name.description: Unique rule identifier; defaults to the file name when omitted.

description.description: Summary of rule constraints and trigger scenarios. For model_decision rules this description is what the model sees when deciding whether to load the rule.

trigger.description: Activation strategy (community-observed convention, e.g. xcaffold Antigravity renderer). Always-on rules may omit the key entirely.

activation.description: Legacy activation key observed in real plugin rule files (e.g. self-customizer ships 'activation: always'). Accepts both spellings.

globs.description: File path glob patterns matching files that trigger this rule (for glob activation). Accepts a comma-joined string or an array of patterns.
